claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tolbutamide is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM; it is a sulfonylurea that closes pancreatic beta-cell KATP channels at low micromolar concentrations but does not kill cancer cell lines, and any weak antiproliferative effect would reflect nonspecific sulfonylurea/off-target activity rather than a shared cytotoxic mechanism.
